question.problem: What is the sum of the series $\pi -\frac{{\pi }^{3}}{3!}+\frac{{\pi }^{5}}{5!}-⋯+\frac{(-1)^{n}{\pi }^{2n+1}}{(2n+1)!}+⋯\,?$
question.worked_solution:
We recognize that the series looks similar to the Maclaurin expansion for $f(x)=\operatorname{sin}⁡x.$

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{sin}⁡x & =x-\frac{{x}^{3}}{3!}+\frac{{x}^{5}}{5!}-⋯+\frac{(-1)^{n}{x}^{2n+1}}{(2n+1)!}+⋯\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting $x=\pi $ into our Maclaurin expansion gives

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{sin}⁡\pi  & =\pi -\frac{{\pi }^{3}}{3!}+\frac{{\pi }^{5}}{5!}-\frac{{\pi }^{7}}{7!}+⋯+\frac{(-1)^{n}{\pi }^{2n+1}}{(2n+1)!}+⋯ \\ 0 & =\pi -\frac{{\pi }^{3}}{3!}+\frac{{\pi }^{5}}{5!}-\frac{{\pi }^{7}}{7!}+⋯+\frac{(-1)^{n}{\pi }^{2n+1}}{(2n+1)!}+⋯\,.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the sum of the series is $0.$
